title: boerhavia erecta var. intermedia
intro: Boerhavia erecta var. intermedia, commonly known as Red Spiderling or Red Stem Spiderling, is a succulent plant species native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia and Africa. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive disorders. The therapeutic actions of Boerhavia erecta var. intermedia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, making it useful for alleviating symptoms of arthritis, gout, and kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
